lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in approximately five identifiable vertical columns with 4-5 nodes per column in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like appearance on the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge to a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, less ordered high-luminance spots compared to the larger, grid-aligned spots on the lateral flank.
